scope: Independent deterministic hidden-evidence, budgeted information acquisition and source-grounded allocation experiment; not a new owner

world.group: visible binary cue sampled equiprobably, no phase label visible to selector
world.latent_z: hidden 1-bit suffix drawn with phase/group probabilities; not in initial Evidence
world.target: parity(prefix) XOR latent_z; latent_z unavailable without bounded paid MEDIUM/SLOW/OBSERVE
world.medium_hint: paid and separately generated hint agrees with latent_z with probability 0.75; never pre-visible
world.world_feedback: one source/session/revision-bound terminal receipt with observed target and success for selected action, after the decision; no future observations

MEDIUM.information: pay for separate noisy hint of latent_z

OBSERVE.information: if scan_available, pay for fresh exact latent_z observation

SLOW.information: pay to expose latent_z through bounded deep diagnostic

cost.ticks: synthetic World decision-time units; selector overhead separately measured, not physical time or energy
cost.viability: health > worst-case damage, and SLOW forbidden if hunger<=2; any ineligible choice ABSTAIN

learning.allocation_prior: Beta(1,1); infer FAST reliability per group from only FAST World receipts; uncertainty means escalate if capable
learning.learned_policy: on every fifth opportunity choose FAST if eligible; otherwise if FAST posterior >=0.75 choose FAST, else choose cheapest viable exact information channel OBSERVE then SLOW, followed by MEDIUM then FAST if needed
learning.no_feedback: same policy and opportunity clock, but do not update retained reliability
learning.cheap_history: last-eight source-validated observed latent_z labels per group; choose FAST one-tick using majority MAP; tie chooses 0; no paid diagnostics
learning.simple_switch: same as learned but a separate low-overhead sliding reliability threshold; after failure use paid diagnostic if feasible; no additional semantic owner
learning.source_rule: only post-action terminal World outcome may update; evaluator latent never read by chooser

comparison.paired_exogenous_cases: same underlying seed/cases and hidden facts across all arms, independent policy state
comparison.primary: heldout total correct/incorrect/abstain, disjoint viability, total work + selector work and World ticks
comparison.secondary: phase mode counts, observed FAST failures, per-group next expensive choice after witnessed failure (censor), feedback/no-feedback paired choice divergences, fatigue/exposure separated
comparison.cheap_null: CHEAP_HISTORY strong source-matched cheap learned controller; FAST_ONLY cheap fixed; no cheap oracle access
comparison.evaluator_oracle: privileged-only diagnostic bound; excluded from fair rankings
comparison.anti_oracle: no phase, latent_z, medium_hint, outcome, seed or prior true distribution in selection Evidence
comparison.cost_sensitivity: include selector overhead; no conversion from synthetic work to joules; alternative scalar score optional only with published weights

hard_bounds: no source mutation outside three new experiment-local files
no physical inference, GPU, GGUF, Minecraft
no new scheduler or semantic owner
